clinical_trials.brief_summary: This is a phase 3, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study to evaluate new or worsening lens opacifications in men with non-metastatic prostate cancer receiving denosumab for bone loss due to androgen deprivation therapy.

relevance.reasoning: 主要終點為水晶體混濁（安全性監測），而非 DR 療效評估；試驗設計為排除 Denosumab 致白內障之安全疑慮，結果無法直接推論至 DR 治療效益。提供眼部暴露的人體安全性資料。

literature.title: Denosumab, for osteoporosis, reduces the incidence of type 2 diabetes, risk of foot ulceration and all-cause mortality in adults, compared with bisphosphonates: An analysis of real-world, cohort data, with a systematic review and meta-analysis.
literature.abstract: To evaluate the impact of denosumab on (i) the incidence of type 2 diabetes (T2D), and (ii) long-term health outcomes (microvascular [neuropathy, retinopathy, nephropathy] and macrovascular [cardiovascular disease, cerebrovascular accident] complications, and all-cause mortality) in patients with T2D, before (iii) combining results with prior studies using meta-analysis.

literature.title: Evaluation of Usage of a Fracture Risk Assessment by FRAX Tool in Adults With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus.
literature.abstract: Fragility fractures are increasingly recognized as a complication of type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). The FRAX-Port® is a calculation tool that assesses the 10-year risk of either major and hip fracture, integrating several clinical risk factors, including T2DM. We aimed to evaluate the fracture risk in adults with T2DM and determine the rate of patients at high risk for fracture under anti-osteoporotic therapy.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: （1）Denosumab 已被報告可降低 T2DM 發生率（PMID 38899553），間接減少糖尿病視網膜病變風險母群；（2）RANKL 在視網膜 Müller 細胞及周細胞中表現，理論上抑制可減少炎性損傷；（3）NCT00925600 為 Phase 3 眼部安全性試驗（水晶體混濁），提供眼部藥物暴露的間接人體資料。惟現有文獻均屬間接路徑，無直接 DR 療效證據。

literature.title: Denosumab-induced cutaneous hypersensitivity reaction with distinct clinical and histopathologic findings.
literature.abstract: Cutaneous reactions from targeted biologics are increasingly common. We describe a case of a cutaneous lichenoid drug eruption from the RANK inhibitor denosumab and a previously unreported lymphohistiocytic reaction pattern. The clinical and histopathological details of this case will aid in recognition, diagnosis, and treatment of drug rashes from denosumab.

literature.title: Denosumab for the reduction of bone loss in postmenopausal osteoporosis: a review.
literature.abstract: Osteoporosis is a prevalent condition that may lead to increased risks for bone fracture and other morbidities and increased health care costs. Treatment modalities for osteoporosis aim to prevent further bone loss and to reduce the risk for fracture. Denosumab is a human monoclonal antibody developed for use in osteoporosis. It inhibits the receptor activator of nuclear factor κB ligand, a cytokine that mediates osteoclast-mediated bone resorption.

literature.title: Erythema nodosum with incidental calciphylaxis secondary to zoledronic acid and denosumab.
literature.abstract: Erythema nodosum (EN) is the most common clinical presentation of panniculitis, an inflammatory process that affects subcutaneous cellular tissue, characterized by the acute appearance of painful erythematous nodules predominantly in the lower extremities. An unusual case of EN is presented below, secondary to the administration of zoledronic acid (ZA) and denosumab, in which incidental histopathological findings of calciphylaxis were also found.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: RANKL 在皮膚角質細胞及朗格漢斯細胞中表現，參與 UV 誘導的免疫抑制（NCT01978483 正是基於此假說）。然而，現有文獻幾乎全部記錄 Denosumab 誘發的皮膚不良事件（AGEP、DRESS、苔蘚樣反應、血管炎），顯示 RANKL 抑制對皮膚免疫具有雙向或不可預測效應。以皮膚炎為治療目標存在明確安全疑慮。

relevance.reasoning: Phase 3 RCT，設計嚴謹（雙盲、安慰劑對照），直接以水晶體混濁為終點，n=769 統計力充足。惟需釐清：（a）試驗方向為安全性排除或療效確認；（b）受試者是否為糖尿病患者；（c）結果發表狀態。若試驗結果顯示 Denosumab 不增加白內障風險，此為必要的安全基礎，但需另行設計療效試驗。

literature.title: Risk of Cataract Surgery and Age-Related Macular Degeneration After Initiation of Denosumab vs Zoledronic Acid for Osteoporosis: A Multi-Database Cohort Study.
literature.abstract: There is a relative lack of head-to-head comparisons of denosumab against other osteoporosis drugs on safety. We aimed to explore ocular outcomes in patients with osteoporosis initiating denosumab vs zoledronic acid.

literature.title: Denosumab treatment for juvenile Paget's disease: results from two adult patients with osteoprotegerin deficiency ("Balkan" mutation in the TNFRSF11B gene).
literature.journal: The Journal of clinical endocrinology and metabolism
literature.abstract: Most patients with juvenile Paget's disease (JPD) have homozygous loss-of-function mutations in the TNFRSF11B gene resulting in osteoprotegerin deficiency. Because recombinant osteoprotegerin is not available for clinical use, an alternative therapeutic approach could be denosumab, which acts on the same pathway.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: （1）NCT00925600（Phase 3, n=769）直接評估 Denosumab 對水晶體混濁的影響，為現有最相關人體資料；（2）PMID 32026309 為 Denosumab vs Zoledronic acid 比較白內障手術風險的真實世界隊列研究，是唯一具治療意義的比較資料；（3）RANKL 路徑在水晶體上皮細胞氧化壓力和凋亡調控中的潛在角色提供機轉假說。注意：NCT00925600 設計目的可能為排除安全疑慮，而非確認療效。

predicted_indications.disease_name: secondary interstitial lung disease specific to childhood associated with a connective tissue disease

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 兒童結締組織病相關間質性肺病（CTD-ILD）病因複雜，主要治療為免疫抑制劑。RANK/RANKL 路徑在肺纖維化中有部分研究，但尚無 Denosumab 用於肺部疾病的臨床資料。兒童族群的 RANKL 抑制安全性顧慮（骨骼發育）未被充分研究。
痤瘡瘢痕疙瘩（keloid acne）涉及過度纖維增生，RANKL 路徑在瘢痕形成中有間接理論連結（RANKL 影響皮膚纖維母細胞活化）。然而，此為極弱的機轉假說，缺乏任何實驗或臨床資料佐證。
無肌病性皮肌炎（ADM）為自體免疫疾病，與間質性肺病及惡性腫瘤高度相關。RANKL 在肌肉及皮膚炎症中有潛在角色，但無任何 Denosumab 用於皮肌炎的臨床前或臨床資料。高惡性腫瘤共病率亦需評估 RANKL 抑制的腫瘤影響。
